title: Weekly Recap
message:
We didn’t just win this week — we **set the tone**. **Season 130, Week 1** ends with POAP KINGS in **1st place** at **10,000 fame** and **+20 war trophies**, and the bigger story is what that implies: our war trend is officially **pointing up**. When the whole river is quiet around us (and yeah, the podium behind us posted **0 fame**), the teams that keep moving are the teams that climb. We moved.

The engine room was stacked. **raquaza** led the charge with **3,050 fame (16 decks)**, with **66** right on the crown at **3,000 fame (14 decks)**, and **Vijay** delivering **2,850 fame (16 decks)**. That’s not “good participation,” that’s race-winning volume. And it wasn’t just the top three either — **King Thing (2,700)** and **Chanco (2,300)** kept the pressure on until the finish was inevitable. This is what “serious about wars” looks like in practice: decks used, points banked, trophies earned.

Outside the river, ladder and progression stayed spicy. **JaxikoLane** had an unreal growth week: **+10 King Levels**, **+1 Path of Legend league**, and a **+319 current trophy jump** (with **+321 best trophies**). **Chanco** kept climbing in the rare air with **+306 best trophies** and **+283 current**, plus another Path of Legend step. **Ditaka** came in swinging: **+1 PoL league** and **+328 current trophies**. And shoutout to **shimmeringhost** for the biggest raw jump: **+671 trophies (2,085 → 2,756)** — that’s a “welcome to the Kings” entrance.

Clan backbone stayed strong too: **800 donations** on the week, with the current donation pace led by **Chanco (134)**, **Vijay (112)**, **JaxikoLane (106)**, **King Thing (104)**, and **Ditaka (96)**. That’s how we keep everyone’s decks sharp without needing to beg for cards. Also: welcome to this week’s arrivals — **ﾑ尺ﾑ乃ﾑｲん**, **shimmeringhost**, **stewart**, and **Ditaka**. You’re joining during the founding-era climb, not after it.

Looking ahead: war is back to a fresh slate right now, and our win condition is still simple — if you can play, **use your 4 war decks** and keep that upward trophy drift rolling.
